topic: A drainage model with a limited purpose
grammarFocus: 学术论证的限定、因果、对比与证据范围
title: A drainage model with a limited purpose
instructions: 原创学术微训练；场景、机构与数值均为虚构模拟，不是事实报道或官方试题。先独立盲听答题，再用原句核对限定、比较与因果。短篇专项不能替代完整陌生测评。
transcript:
Tutor: What does your model of the school playground predict?
Ana: How quickly a shallow pool drains through different surfaces. I tested gravel, paving and compacted soil in identical trays.
Tutor: Were the water volumes equal?
Ana: Yes, two litres per tray. I first planned one litre, but the pool disappeared too quickly to time consistently.
Tutor: What was the main result?
Ana: The gravel tray drained fastest. That does not prove gravel is the best surface for the whole playground, because we did not test wheelchair access or maintenance.
Tutor: What other limitation should the report state?
Ana: The trays had no slope. The real site slopes towards the entrance, so water may collect differently there.
Tutor: How many times did you repeat the procedure?
Ana: Five times for each material, using the same pouring height. I kept the slowest result rather than removing it as inconvenient.
Tutor: Was that a faulty measurement?
Ana: We do not know. The video shows a brief blockage near the outlet. I will describe it and show the results with and without that trial, clearly labelled.
Tutor: What happens next?
Ana: A site visit on Friday to measure the slope. Our present recommendation is another test, not immediate construction.
